a large number of children with JIA reach a period of inactive state during the first year of treatment.

a substantial proportion of children with juvenile idiopathic arthritic (JIA) achieve inactive disease with current therapies and that the time between symptom onset and specialised rheumatological care is an important predictor for this outcome.
